PUBG Mobile In-Game Items and Event Collectibles

In-game item listings can refer to event collectibles, cosmetic resources or mode-specific objects. The same marketing term may represent different quantities and unlock conditions. This directory gives buyers a framework for checking item details rather than guessing from a short product title.

Browse all In-Game Items listings

Check the game, event and item identity

A collectible's name should be matched with the actual in-game event or mode where it is used. Some items exist in a temporary creator experience, others are permanent cosmetic unlocks and some may only appear during a limited campaign. Do not assume two similarly named items are interchangeable. Confirm the item name, level or star rating and the game version whenever those details matter.

A seller's picture may depict promotional art rather than the exact item or quantity currently available. A description should identify what the user receives, not merely show a colorful icon.

Quantity and progression change value

A single item, bundle of ten or fully upgraded collectible can have very different meaning. Review the stated quantity and progression stage separately, and check whether the item requires additional in-game steps to become usable. A max label is not meaningful without the level system it refers to. If the listing does not name its progression system, clarify it before relying on the claim.

Do not infer that a game mode's points or collectibles can be converted to official UC, real-world value or account inventory unless the publisher expressly supports it.

Verify delivery rules before paying

Not all virtual items may be gifted or transferred. Rules can vary by region, event and account status. PUBG Mobile restricts virtual transactions except when allowed by its instructions. Any offer that requests passwords, recovery email access, a modified game client or a third-party unlocker carries avoidable risk. Use official in-game mechanisms and read current terms.

A phrase such as fast delivery does not specify eligibility, operating hours or stock. International shoppers should confirm the supported country, full USD cost and expected process in advance.
